title: FakeAgent Claude Desktop installer URL
description: The exact reported FakeAgent installer host and path appear in a tool command or uniquely correlated network observation. This does not prove download or execution.
falsepositives: Authorized investigation may fetch the reported URL.

investigation: Verify full URL, HTTP response and payload hash, subsequent file writes or process execution, and approved task scope.

classification.rationale: An installer destination alone does not prove AI manipulation or an ATLAS technique.
